description: Na₉Sc(MoO₄)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.96 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five MoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.57 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.11 Å) and three longer (2.12 Å) Sc-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.84 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.83 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom.
